card.name: Commas in lists of enzyme-inducing drugs
card.fires_on: The comma (or "e.g.,") inside a parenthetical list of liver enzyme-inducing drugs such as phenobarbital, phenytoin, carbamazepine and rifampin, in drug interaction text.

modes.label: Comma between inducers
modes.description: A comma right after one inducer drug name, before the next one in the list.

modes.label: After e.g.
modes.description: The comma after "e.g." that opens a list of inducers.

card.plain: It fires on the commas that separate drugs like phenobarbital, phenytoin and carbamazepine in lists of drugs that speed up liver metabolism.
